SeasonTravelRequest.title: SeasonTravelRequest
SeasonTravelRequest.description:
Shared club profile (`club: null` = sample club) plus the travel options.

`electricity_price_km_per_kwh` is part of the shared format but unused here: travel costs
use fuel and coach-hire prices.

Upgrade.title: Upgrade
Upgrade.description:
One upgrade the action plan can recommend (backend/app/reference/upgrades.json).

Which fields are set depends on the kind of upgrade:
- share of one electricity use (LED, insulation): cost_km + saves_share_of + share
- solar: kwp + cost_km_per_kwp + self_use_share
- travel (car-sharing): cost_km + cuts_car_trips_share

Vehicles.title: Vehicles
Vehicles.description: Vehicles used for one away trip of one team.
